(September 2026)": 249 top-level comments, 2 kept, both with the location as the first segment ("NYC | ONSITE (hybrid) ...", "Remote (US) Close (...) | ..."). UNCLEAR: the Y Combinator terms (https://www.ycombinator.com/legal/, "Site") say "you will not engage in or use any data mining, robots, scraping or similar data gathering or extraction methods", while the HN Search API on Algolia (https://hn.algolia.com/api) is a public, unauthenticated, documented endpoint. No capture of the terms page is committed; the quote was read at that URL on 2026-10-24 and is unverifiable from this repository. Whether that API counts as "the Site" is a question for the owner, which was put to him and is unanswered, so the source stays blocked. robots.txt of news.ycombinator.com sets Crawl-delay: 30 and does not disallow /item; hn.algolia.com serves no robots.txt (404). Employers are NOT given by the API: a comment is free text whose first paragraph is a header, so every observation is tagged employer-unverified. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short text to limit exposure).
